subject: general
question: The Government of India’s Ministry of Culture organised a programme called Vitasta in January 2023. This programme exhibits rich culture, arts and crafts of which region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashmir**__..

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vitasta program was organized at **Mahatma Mandir, Gandhinagar, in Gujarat.**
 
• The event aimed to showcase the rich cultural heritage, arts, and crafts of Jammu and Kashmir, providing a platform for **local artisans and performers** to exhibit their work. 
 
• The **Minister of Culture in India is G. Kishan Reddy.** He has been in office since July 2021 and is responsible for promoting and preserving the cultural heritage of India.
